description: Save the user's current job preferences as a new named saved search, the same as saving a search on the dashboard. Pass name (optional; without one, the search is named after the first role and location) and alerts_enabled (optional; true emails the user new matches for this search). It adds a search and changes nothing else; it can be removed with getmattered_delete_saved_search. Nothing is sent to any employer and nothing is spent. Do not use it to change what the user is matched with; use getmattered_update_job_preferences. Next: getmattered_list_saved_searches.

alerts_enabled.description: true emails the user new matches for this search, false stops the emails.

name.description: The name of the new search, up to 120 characters. Without one, it is named after the first role and location.
